boy.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: five-panel opening storyboard for the original pixel farming game Dewfield. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, preserve its exact five-panel layout, all panel boundaries, environments, lighting, warm amber/olive/cream palette, camera angles, all NPCs and storytelling actions. Image 2 is the definitive IN-GAME FARMER IDENTITY REFERENCE. Replace ONLY the protagonist farmer in panels 3 (upper-right receiving key), 4 (lower-left receiving seeds) and 5 (lower-right kneeling by chicks). Also update the little framed childhood portrait in panel 1 to the same protagonist gender and hairstyle. Keep panel 2 bus scenery unchanged. Crucially the story farmer must look like the actual game character in Image 2, not a generic traveler: preserve the same face, hair shape and color, shirt color and sleeves, dark navy bib overalls with brass clasps, compact proportions and brown boots. No backpack, no bedroll, no hat, no different outfit. Keep the protagonist's original size, position, orientation, pose and actions within each panel. All identities must remain consistent across the three panels. Retain crisp carefully placed pixel clusters and 3/4 top-down farming-game art, not a smooth illustration. No text or labels or watermark. The protagonist is the BOY from Image 2: tousled short chestnut hair, softly spiky layered top and short nape, open friendly face, muted olive-khaki short-sleeve work shirt, navy overalls and brown work boots. No long hair, no ponytail, no hair clip. Keep the boy recognizably identical to the referenced in-game male sprite at cinematic scale.
